common_name: Encore Autumn Dove Azalea (Reblooming Upright White Single-Form Azalea)

planting.note: Plant in spring or fall after cool weather returns; mulch to protect roots through the first winter.

directions: Autumn Dove carries snowy white, single-form blossoms roughly 2 to 2.5 inches across on a dense, upright plant, with a faint cool-green flush in the throat of each flower. Like other members of the Encore line, it was bred for a heavier-than-usual summer and fall rebloom on top of the traditional spring flush, giving a much longer season of color than older once-blooming azaleas. It was introduced with West Coast growing conditions specifically in mind, so it tends to perform well in drier summer climates when given consistent moisture. Grow in acidic, well-drained soil with morning sun and afternoon shade in hot climates, and apply an azalea-formulated fertilizer after each bloom flush.

common_name: Encore Autumn Kiss Azalea (Reblooming Semi-Double Pink Bicolor Azalea)

planting.note: Plant in spring or fall in acidic, well-drained soil; give morning sun with light afternoon shade in hot-summer climates.

directions: Autumn Kiss opens semi-double, watercolor-toned blooms with rich pink edges that soften into a blush, nearly white center, giving each flower visible depth compared to a single flat color. Plants mature into a compact, rounded 3 to 4 foot mound of glossy evergreen foliage, and like the rest of the Encore series they flower in heavy waves in spring and then push out repeat flushes through summer and fall rather than blooming only once. It is broadly adapted from USDA zones 6a through 10b, and afternoon shade helps preserve bloom color in the hottest parts of its range. Feed with an acid-forming fertilizer after each bloom cycle to encourage the next flush.

common_name: Encore Autumn Moonstruck Azalea (Reblooming Variegated-Leaf White Azalea)

planting.note: Plant in spring or fall in acidic, well-drained soil; the upright habit suits hedges and accent plantings as well as containers.

directions: Autumn Moonstruck pairs clean, brilliant white blooms with bold green-and-cream variegated foliage, making it the first Encore release bred for stable leaf variegation rather than flower color alone. The upright habit reaches about 5 feet tall and 4 feet wide at maturity, larger and more vertical than many earlier dwarf Encore selections, and suits it well to hedging or accent use. As with the rest of the Encore line it reblooms in spring, summer, and fall rather than flowering only once, and it performs best in full sun to partial shade. Grow in acidic, well-drained soil and feed with an azalea-formulated fertilizer after each bloom flush to support the next round of color.
